Original game descriptions agree on Zevran’s three outcomes, but describe Murder of Crows value 2 as killing Nuncio to save Zevran rather than the broader Keep/editor wording of offering to help; retain the documented numeric assignment without asserting that Nuncio died. All eight released presets corroborate 2/2. No new gameplay confirmation is claimed. Both controls remain independent of each other, Origins Zevran survival/recruitment/romance, Hawke’s class, siblings and other history; no Keep dependency gates or automatic edits are introduced.

da2.finding_nathaniel.label: Finding Nathaniel
da2.finding_nathaniel.basis: These choices are not covered by the author’s documentation, so the supplied World State Editor is the fallback. Its 0/1/2 assignments agree with original game descriptions and captured Keep metadata. Direct readback of all eight released mods corroborates Nathaniel 2 and Gamlen 1. Nathaniel 0 refers to not surviving Awakening, not a newly asserted death during Hawke’s rescue. Gamlen uses the actual da2_act2-prefixed field at DA2 index 16 but belongs in Act III, as in the editor and Keep. No new gameplay observation is claimed. Each selector owns only its enum; Origins Nathaniel history, Hawke identity, siblings, companions and all unrelated fields remain unchanged.
